description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This leadership role is crucial in supporting the Director of Nursing and ensuring the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence within the facility. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and thrive in a dynamic healthcare environment, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a vital role in supervising nursing staff, overseeing daily clinical operations, and contributing to the development and implementation of care policies. This position offers a competitive salary range and the opportunity to advance your career in a supportive setting. Join a team committed to providing exceptional care and fostering a positive work environment.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience.
